name: DFlow Solana Trade
description: Official plugin: natural-language Solana spot swaps via DFlow Trading API + Helius RPC. Preview-first quotes; live execution gated by SOLANA_TRADE_LIVE.

DFLOW_API_KEY.label: DFlow API key
DFLOW_API_KEY.help: x-api-key for https://quote-api.dflow.net (prod). Dev host works without a key.

DFLOW_TRADE_API_URL.label: Trade API URL
DFLOW_TRADE_API_URL.help: Default: https://quote-api.dflow.net when key set, else https://dev-quote-api.dflow.net

HELIUS_RPC_URL.label: Helius RPC URL
HELIUS_RPC_URL.help: Solana RPC for balance + sendTransaction (SOLANA_RPC_URL also accepted)

SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY.label: Wallet private key (base58)
SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY.help: Required only for live signed swaps

SOLANA_TRADE_LIVE.label: Enable live swaps
SOLANA_TRADE_LIVE.help: Must be true to broadcast. Default preview-only.

DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.label: DeepSeek API key
DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.help: Optional LLM key — plugin tools work with any model provider
